_comment_silhouette: This map's ocean is a single FLAT FILL (16,6,175), so land is exact rather than thresholded - the union of the regions its own drawn black lines enclose, minus the handful of oversized 'cells' that are the off-map background and the legend panel. Every other source here forced a judgement about where water started: a chromaticity distance on the Immortal Empires parchment, and on the Old World fan map a luminance cut that even after being calibrated against hand-drawn sea markings reached only 81% balanced accuracy. A registration can be no better than the silhouette it is scored against, which is why this source displaced the IE family as primary.
_comment_coarse: Bounds bracket a wide reconnaissance sweep (scale_x 0.30-0.95, scale_y 0.25-0.85 step 0.025, offsets -30..110 / -50..90 step 6, 359k candidates, 266 s) which peaked INTERIOR at scale (0.450, 0.325) offset (36, -14) with two-sided IoU 0.5249 - already above the IE family's affine 0.5017, and measured against an exact silhouette rather than a thresholded one. Reduced pixels: silhouette downsampled by src_step, canvas by canvas_step.
_comment_landmarks: Independent check only - these take no part in the silhouette fit. Source side on this map, anchor side on the Terraqueous globe, whose pixels become canvas pixels through the committed NE-II fit so no canvas coordinate is eyeballed. They are read off a thumbnail and are worth roughly +-150 canvas px, so treat a few hundred px of landmark residual as a measure of the reads, not of the fit.

record.notes: Flat-filled fan map of the Total War Warhammer world with region boundaries drawn as black lines - the PRIMARY boundary source from S3a onward. Three properties put it ahead of everything else tried: its ocean is a flat fill so the land silhouette is exact rather than thresholded; its region lines sit on flat terrain fills, so labelling the complement gives 681 clean closed cells with no local-contrast ink test, no lettering to inpaint and no coastal shadow band to mistake for a border; and 681 cells against our 659 land-state target means the source's own regions become our states almost one-for-one, instead of a thousand noisy cells being merged down. Contributes interior boundaries only - never coastline (coastline precedence 5). The committed land_sea_mask.png remains the sole coastline authority.
